package.description: A full-featured XML Editor (or XML IDE)

en-US.description: A full-featured XML Editor (or XML IDE)
en-US.longDescription:
XMLBlueprint is a full-featured XML Editor (or XML IDE) that supports the creation and editing of
- XML Documents
- DTDs
- Relax NG Schemas
- Schematron
- XML Schemas
- XSLT Stylesheets
XMLBlueprint includes numerous intelligent editing features that help you create well-formed, valid XML quickly and easily. It supports Unicode which means you can edit and validate XML Documents in almost any language.
en-US.name: XMLBlueprint 22

zh-CN.description: 一款功能齐全的 XML 编辑器（或 XML IDE）
zh-CN.longDescription:
XMLBlueprint 是一款功能齐全的 XML 编辑器（或 XML IDE），支持创建和编辑
- XML 文档
- DTD
- Relax NG 模式
- Schematron
- XML 模式
- XSLT 样式表
XMLBlueprint 包含众多智能编辑功能，可帮助您快速轻松地创建格式良好且有效的 XML。它支持 Unicode，这意味着您可以使用几乎任何语言来编辑和验证 XML 文档。
